item.title: LOT-087: message actions menu and typed JS bridge
item.body:
LOT-087 Closes #179 Claim: cloud/lot-087 ## Problem The reader has no per-message menu, and `reader.js` messages were read as untyped `Any` bodies. ## What changed - `MessageMenuPolicy` (pure): port of the legacy 13-action policy, same titles and order (`Link` stays `Link`). `isOwnMessage`, `canBeFavorite`, `canDelete` derive from LOT-031's `MessageActions`. - `ReaderBridgeMessage`: five known names decoded into a closed enum; unknown names, non-objects, booleans/fractions as numbers, missing fields, post < 1, unknown `source` are rejected whole. `ReaderWebController.receive` now goes through it. - `MessageActionRegistry` + `MessageActionHandler`: an action without a merged handler is hidden; a later lot registers its handler in `TopicReaderView.installMenuActions()` without touching the policy. - `Link`: copies the permalink (page URL without fragment + `#t`, HFR-PROTOCOL §6c). Only handler in this lot. - Reader: `ReaderMessage.actions` (LOT-031 parser, one set per block), `ReaderPage.pageURL`, `⋯` button + tappable author (only when a handler exists, none on the continuation copy), `confirmationDialog`, `TopicReaderModel.requestMenu` / `perform(_:in:)`. - Spec `docs/lots/LOT-087-message-actions.md` (legacy counterpart @ 2440d79, AGENTS.md §4 pointer comment in `MessageMenuAction.swift`). Not wider: no handler other than Link (edit, delete, quote, alert, AQ, bookmark, BL/WL, profile, MP, flag stay with their lots; the avatar menu is empty and opens nothing for now). ## Tests `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Actions/`: `MessageMenuPolicyTests` (legacy cases ported), `ReaderBridgeMessageTests`, `MessageActionRegistryTests`, `TopicReaderMenuTests`; additions in `TopicHTMLBuilderTests` and `LiveTopicPageSourceTests` (R20/R21 real pages). Cloud checks: the pure files and their three suites compile and pass under `swift test` on Linux (25 tests); three mutations (drop the first-post rule, drop the boolean guard, drop the handler filter) make 10 expectations fail. SwiftLint clean on `App/SwiftHFR/Reader` and tests. Model, builder and view code is **not compiled locally** (no Xcode in the cloud): the `App build + tests` CI job is the first compile. ## Pending capture - #273 (own post on a public topic): the policy uses LOT-031's own-post rule (edit link) and `RA4`; review #330 checks it. - Alert mail fallback, multi-quote cookie state (LOT-086) and the "flag here" favourite action (state-changing GET, needs session check and `TopicFlagFlow`) are left to their handler lots; no handler, so hidden. - May conflict with #460 / #462 (both touch the reader); merge dev-swift here when one lands. ## Mac check needed (for `mac/m2-lead`) - [ ] `xcodebuild build test` on iPhone 18 Pro and an iPad simulator (iOS 27.0): new suites green. - [ ] Reader on a logged-in page: each message shows `⋯`; tap opens the dialog; "Link" copies `…-sujet__

.htm#t`, paste it in Notes and open it: lands on the message. - [ ] Real `CFBoolean` guard: `ReaderBridgeMessage.decode` rejects a JS `true` as token/post (tests use Foundation values on Linux). - [ ] Author button (tap on the pseudo): opens nothing today (no avatar handler); the tap must not scroll or select text. - [ ] Own post (#273 capture if possible): menu holds Link only (no edit handler yet); first post of a topic never offers delete once that lot lands. - [ ] Light, dark, Dynamic Type XL: header with `⋯` button does not wrap badly; "Lien copié" capsule readable, VoiceOver reads the button as "Actions du message de ". - [ ] Logged out and MP topic: `⋯` still appears (Link works), no crash. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_014QH2CH2EaAoiCaU2Qvs1d9)_ ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added message and author menus in the reader. Menu options depend on the message context and available actions. * Added an option to copy a message permalink to the clipboard, with on-screen confirmation. The link points to the message on its topic page.

Walkthrough

Adds message-action menus to the reader. The change parses message links, renders menu controls, validates WebKit messages with a typed decoder, and routes available actions through a handler registry. The registered Link action copies a message permalink. **Changes: Reader message actions** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Menu policy and action handlers**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Actions/MessageMenuAction.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Actions/MessageActionRegistry.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Actions/MessageMenuPolicyTests.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Actions/MessageActionRegistryTests.swift`, `docs/lots/LOT-087-message-actions.md`, `docs/CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md`, `AGENTS.md`|Defines menu actions, context, ordering, handler availability, and permalink copying. Tests cover policy and registry behavior. Documentation records implementation details, legacy differences, and learnings.| |**Page data, menu controls, and typed bridge**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderPage.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicPageSource.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicHTMLBuilder.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderWebController.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Actions/ReaderBridgeMessage.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Resources/reader.*`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/LiveTopicPageSourceTests.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/TopicHTMLBuilderTests.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Actions/ReaderBridgeMessageTests.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Actions/ReaderBridgeWiringTests.swift`|Associates parsed action links and the final page URL with reader data. Renders menu controls, sends menu events from JavaScript, and decodes supported WebKit messages. Tests cover parsing, rendering, bridge wiring, and validation.| |**Menu presentation and action execution**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Actions/TopicReaderModel+Menu.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Actions/TopicReaderMenuTests.swift`|Builds context for valid current-page requests and presents available actions. The view performs selected entries through the registry and displays temporary feedback. Tests cover requests, execution, and refresh behavior.| **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~45 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant ReaderJS participant ReaderWebController participant TopicReaderModel participant TopicReaderView participant MessageActionRegistry participant LinkActionHandler ReaderJS->>ReaderWebController: Post menu event with post, source, and token ReaderWebController->>TopicReaderModel: Forward menu event TopicReaderModel->>MessageActionRegistry: Request available entries for context MessageActionRegistry-->>TopicReaderModel: Return ordered entries TopicReaderModel-->>TopicReaderView: Present menu TopicReaderView->>TopicReaderModel: Select menu action TopicReaderModel->>MessageActionRegistry: Perform offered action MessageActionRegistry->>LinkActionHandler: Execute link action LinkActionHandler-->>TopicReaderModel: Copy permalink and set confirmation feedback ``` **Possibly related issues** - [ezzz/HFRnow#330](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/330): The issue checks own-post menu eligibility against a capture. This change defines and tests own-post eligibility, but the supplied summaries do not establish that it uses the specified capture. - [ezzz/HFRnow#222](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/222): This change adds the handler registry that a later Bookmark action can use. It does not implement Bookmark behavior. - [ezzz/HFRnow#216](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/216): This change adds handler availability for menu actions. It does not implement the later favorite-action handler. - [ezzz/HFRnow#224](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/224): This change adds the handler registry for later AQ integration. It does not implement the AQ handler. - [ezzz/HFRnow#225](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/225): This change adds the handler registry for later alert integration. It does not implement the alert handler. **Possibly related PRs** - [ezzz/HFRnow#28](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/28): This PR adds the per-message action parser used by this change to attach action links to reader messages. - [ezzz/HFRnow#257](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/257): This PR creates reader components extended here, including the WebKit message path, reader page, page source, HTML builder, JavaScript, and reader model. **Suggested labels:** `type: lot`
Merge Risk: Low · up to d7df5

The Link menu may be difficult to tap. The change is otherwise mergeable with that usability issue noted.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to d7df5

The current feature only copies a message link and rejects invalid requests. No material security issue was demonstrated in that flow. Actions that later modify messages will need an explicit contract for handling selections after navigation or other context changes. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _observed_ — The sole production registration is Link. It copies a native permalink to the system pasteboard and announces confirmation. The permalink uses the displayed page URL with the selected post fragment, not a parsed action-link URL; the installed handler performs no forum mutation or network request. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — The reader script and message channel use a named WebKit content world rather than the page world. Native receipt requires a main-frame message, successful typed decoding, and the current document token. Menu presentation independently checks that token and requires a matching non-continuation message on the displayed page. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — A presented menu captures context without a document token. Execution checks the captured entries and current handler availability, but does not revalidate document identity or consume a unique selection. Successful loads dismiss the menu, yet an already captured selection can still execute. With the currently installed Link handler, stale or repeated execution only copies the captured permalink; privileged future handlers are not covered by that bounded outcome. **Hardening Proposals** - _proposed_ — Before registering state-changing handlers, define which captured selections remain valid after document or account changes, and enforce the required execution-time identity, authority, cancellation, and duplicate-execution guarantees. Preserve snapshot behavior only where its effects are intentionally safe.

The changes cover the policy, the bridge decoder, the handler registry, the Link handler, the reader model and view wiring for the menu, the HTML builder button rend… |
Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title "LOT-087: message actions menu and typed JS bridge" matches the main changes. The PR adds a per-message actions menu (MessageMenuPolicy, MessageActionRegistry, TopicReaderView confirmation dialog) and a typed decoder for reader.js messages (ReaderBridgeMessage). It names a real ticket identifier, but the ticket code alone does not describe the change. The title is specific and accurate, and a teammate scanning history can identify the primary change.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changed areas connect to `#179`. The changes cover the policy, the bridge decoder, the handler registry, the Link handler, the reader model and view wiring for the menu, the HTML builder button rendering, the LOT-031 action parser, and the page URL. Tests cover these parts. Documentation covers the LOT-087 spec, the AGENTS.md learning entry, and the legacy changelog entry, which records the deliberate difference on first-post delete. That difference is in scope: the delete action has no handler in this lot, so it is not visible to users yet. No unrelated product behavior, dependency, or configuration change is shown in the summary.
Full details: Docstring Coverage

**Explanation** Docstring coverage is 42.42% which is insufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. Docstring coverage is scoped to functions touched by this diff with cyclomatic complexity of at least 2. Documentation-only edits and deletions within surviving functions are included; unchanged diff context and fully deleted functions are excluded. Analyzed 33 functions across 18 files. (3 skipped: 3 unsupported.) **Resolution** Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#179` is the only active directly linked issue, so its coding requirements apply. Code evidence supports these requirements: [`#179`] policy ported with the legacy 13-action order and title 'Link' (MessageMenuPolicy); typed bridge with a closed five-case enum (App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Actions/ReaderBridgeMessage.swift). Its decode rejects unknown names, non-dictionary bodies, missing or mistyped fields, post < 1, unknown source, and non-integer or boolean numbers (CFBoolean guard). The handler registry hides actions without a merged handler. Link copies the permalink. Tests exist for these parts. Three acceptance items lack evidence. (1) The view and model code (TopicReaderModel, TopicReaderView, TopicHTMLBuilder) is not compiled. The PR states that no Xcode run occurred. (2) No green 'xcodebuild build test' result is reported for iPhone 18 Pro or iPad simulator (iOS 27.0), and no green 'App build + tests' CI result is reported. (3) The PR does not show that each new test fails without the change; it reports three policy mutations only. The real CFBoolean check on WebKit values is also pending. Because these results are unknown, the requirement status cannot be decided. Non-coding acceptance items (manual Mac checks, light/dark/Dynamic Type checks) are outside this assessment. Capture `#273` does not block the lot, per the issue. **Resolution** Provide the following evidence: (a) a green 'xcodebuild build test' log, or CI run link, for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPad simulator (iOS 27.0) targets at the reviewed head; (b) a green 'App build + tests' CI job at the reviewed head; (c) evidence that each new Swift Testing case in App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Actions/ and the TopicHTMLBuilder and LiveTopicPageSource additions fails when the change is removed, or a recorded run that shows this for the view-model tests. Then reassess.

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

**Do not clear the banner when its delay task is cancelled.** When a second confirmation replaces the first, SwiftUI cancels the first `.task(id:)`. Its `Task.sleep` throws `CancellationError`. `try?` discards the error, so the first task still calls `model.clearMenuFeedback()`. That call removes the second confirmation almost at once. `clearMenuFeedback()` does not check the serial, so nothing else prevents the clear.
Suggested fix

```diff .task(id: model.menuFeedbackSerial) { - try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(2)) + do { + try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(2)) + } catch { + return // Cancelled by a newer confirmation, which owns the banner. + } model.clearMenuFeedback() } ```
Committable suggestion

> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion @ViewBuilder private var menuFeedbackBanner: some View { if let feedback = model.menuFeedback { Text(feedback) .font(.callout) .padding(.horizontal, 16) .padding(.vertical, 8) .background(.thinMaterial, in: Capsule()) .padding(.bottom, 56) .task(id: model.menuFeedbackSerial) { do { try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(2)) } catch { return // Cancelled by a newer confirmation, which owns the banner. } model.clearMenuFeedback() } } } ```

+# LOT-087 — Message actions menu and typed JS bridge
+
+- **Module:** App (`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Actions/`)
+- **Difficulty / model:** medium (Opus → Fable; coded by a cloud child, reviewed by Opus)
+- **Issue:** [#179](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/179) (its old lot issue is linked from there)
+- **Depends on:** LOT-083 (reader), LOT-031 (`MessageActions`). Absorbs Phase 4 backlog C14 (typed JS bridge) and C15 (message action policy).
+
+## Legacy counterpart
+
+Legacy repository <https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow> at `2440d79`.
+
+| Legacy | Replaced by |
+|---|---|
+| `HFRswift/Swift/MessagesView.swift:111-193` (`MessagePopupMenuActionKind`: 13 actions, titles, symbols, destructive) | `MessageMenuAction` |
+| `:196-275` (`MessagePopupMenuPolicy.orderedActionKinds`, `priority`) | `MessageMenuPolicy.orderedActions` |
+| `:1169-1235` (`Coordinator` `WKScriptMessageHandler`, `scrollState` / `textInteractionState`, bodies read as `Any`) | `ReaderBridgeMessage.decode` (closed set, typed) |
+| `:1722-1775` (entries built per action, each calling a `parent.on…Request` closure) | `MessageActionHandler` registry |
+| `Classes/ObjCMessageActionsBuilder.m:91-104` (`permalinkURLForPostID`: page URL without fragment + `#` + the post id, which is the anchor name `t<n>`) | `TopicReaderModel.permalink(of:on:)` |
+| `HFRswiftTests/MessagePopupMenuPolicyTests.swift` | `MessageMenuPolicyTests` (same cases) |
+
+## Behaviour
+
+- **Bridge.** `reader.js` posts `{type, token, …}`. The app decodes five names (`images`, `tap`, `ready`, `video`, `menu`) into
+  `ReaderBridgeMessage`; an unknown name, a body that is not an object, a non-integer or boolean number, a missing field, a post
+  below 1 or an unknown `source` is rejected whole (nothing is partly read). The page never supplies code or a selector.
+- **Menu button.** Each non-continuation message draws a `⋯` button (`data-menu="message"`) when an action of the message menu has
+  a handler, and its author becomes a button (`data-menu="avatar"`, legacy: the avatar tap) when an action of the author menu
+  (profile, MP, BL, WL) has one; a menu that could never open draws nothing. The `⋯` instead of the legacy "+" is GAP-051's UX change. The page sends `menu` with the number and one of those
+  two names; the model checks the document token and that the page holds the message, then asks the registry.
+- **Policy** (pure, `MessageMenuPolicy`): ported from legacy, same order and titles (`Link` stays `Link`). `isOwnMessage`,
+  `canBeFavorite` and `canDelete` are derived from `MessageActions` as LOT-031 decides (edit link ⇒ own; flag link ⇒ favourite; edit
+  link and not the topic's first message ⇒ delete). The first message is the first non-continuation block of page 1.
+- **Registry.** `MessageActionRegistry` holds `MessageActionHandler`s by `MessageMenuAction.Kind`. An action without handler, or
+  whose handler declines (`isAvailable`), is hidden. `canAQ` and `canBookmark` are the AQ / bookmark handlers' answer. A later lot adds
+  its handler in `TopicReaderView.installMenuActions()`; the policy is untouched.
+- **Link.** `LinkActionHandler` copies the permalink and shows "Lien copié". Permalink = the page's final URL (forum `https`,
+  fragment dropped) + `#t<numreponse>` (HFR-PROTOCOL §6c: permalinks are `#t<message>` on a canonical URL); nil when the page URL is unknown.
+- Only **Link** has a handler in this lot, so authors stay plain text until profile / MP / BL / WL land.
+
+## Edge cases
+
+- Logged out: LOT-031 gives only quote and profile links, so only Link (and Alerter, which needs the handler of its lot) can show.
+- Stale token, unknown or continuation message, empty entry list: nothing opens.
+- Own message: no MP, BL/WL, alert. First message of the topic: no delete.
+- The dialog closes before the action runs, so `perform(_:in:)` takes the menu the user saw.
+
+## Fixtures
+
+`R20` (logged out) and `R21` (logged in) through `LiveTopicPageSource` (`messagesCarryTheirToolbarActions`). No new capture.
+
+**Pending capture:** #273 (own post on a public topic: edit link shape, which MP / flag / alert links remain). Until it lands the
+own-post rules are LOT-031's (`RA4`: edit on own posts of a private thread) and the legacy policy above; review #330 checks them.
+Not decided here, left to the lot of each handler: the alert mail fallback (legacy `onPopupAlertMailRequest`), the multi-quote cookie
+state (`isQuoteSelectionEnabled` stays false until LOT-086), and the "flag here" action (`favorite`: a state-changing GET, needs the
+session check of LOT-044 and `TopicFlagFlow`; no handler yet, so hidden).
+
+## Intentional differences from legacy
+
+1. The bridge decodes into a closed enum (legacy read untyped `Any` bodies, silently ignoring bad shapes).
+2. Actions without a merged handler are hidden, never shown and ignored.
+3. "Link" copies to the pasteboard (issue scope); legacy opened the share sheet.
+4. "Supprimer" is hidden on the first message of the topic (first block of page 1); legacy hid it on the first message of every
+   page (`messageIndex != 0`, `MessagesView.swift:255`; `ObjCMessageActionsBuilder.m:43`). Deleting a topic's first post deletes the
+   whole topic (HFR-PROTOCOL §3.1, `W49`, `R92`); legacy never offered it. Own-message, favourite and delete flags derive from LOT-031's
